Hi Oliver / FinServe IT team,

Thanks again for the interest in Redwood Private. Per our discovery call last week, the security and network teams asked for a technical deep-dive to validate VPC peering/networking options, on-prem footprint, and air-gapped deployment constraints. We'd like to schedule a 60-90 minute architecture review with our infra and solutions folks.

Proposed agenda:
- High-level topology options (VPC peering, Transit, PrivateLink)
- On-prem footprint & deployment paths (k8s vs. baremetal, data connectors)
- Air-gapped requirements & validation (offline images, attestation, patching)
- Key management (KMS/HSM integration) and logging/audit expectations
- Next steps & mutual action items (network diagram, contact points, timeline)

Are any of the following windows good for your team? All times PDT:
- Wed Mar 25: 2:00-3:30 PM
- Thu Mar 26: 9:00-10:30 AM
- Thu Mar 26: 1:00-2:30 PM

I’ll loop in our lead solutions engineer (Dylan) and our deployment PM (Ava) to join. If you have an internal network diagram, can you attach it ahead of time (PDF or Visio)?

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
